description: This file defines the authentication-related API routes for login, registration, and user profile retrieval in a FastAPI application, including user credential validation, JWT token issuance, and user profile creation based on roles.

classes.name: Token
classes.description: Response model representing an authentication token.

classes.name: UserCreate
classes.description: Model for user registration input, including email, password, role, and full name.

classes.name: UserPublic
classes.description: Model representing non-sensitive publicly available user information.

classes.name: UserLogin
classes.description: Model for login via JSON containing email and password.

methods.name: UserPublic _public_user_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Transforms a MongoDB user document into a UserPublic model for external use.

methods.name: Token login(form_data: OAuth2PasswordRequestForm = Depends())
methods.description: Authenticates a user based on OAuth2 form data, returning a JWT token if valid.

methods.name: Token login_json(payload: UserLogin)
methods.description: Authenticates a user via JSON payload, returning a JWT token if valid.

methods.name: UserPublic register_user(payload: UserCreate)
methods.description: Creates a new user, hashing the password, and setting up role-specific profile data.

methods.name: UserPublic me(user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict))
methods.description: Retrieves the current authenticated user's public profile.

ctags.name: me
ctags.pattern: /^async def me(user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user_strict)) -> UserPublic:$/
